checks.defect_origin: Confirmed. Fork commit f1b7aebff8c2 added 'case RISCV::P_BEQIMM: return RISCVCC::COND_EQ' and 'case RISCV::P_BNEIMM: return RISCVCC::COND_NE' (git log pulp/integer_SIMD_fix -S). Upstream f4d2f7a3b798 (XCVbi codegen) is in llvmorg-19.1.7, so at 19 and 20 getBrCond(COND_EQ/NE, Imm=true) returns CV_BEQIMM/CV_BNEIMM.
checks.upstream_faithfulness: 0439a4eca78f is in llvmorg-20.1.8..llvmorg-21.1.8 (not an ancestor of 20.1.8, is an ancestor of 21.1.8). The fork change follows the same design: new enum values placed before COND_INVALID (RISCVInstrInfo.h:44-49), new cases in getCondFromBranchOpc (RISCVInstrInfo.cpp:933-936), getBrCond (:971-974) and getOppositeBranchCondition (:999-1002). insertBranch (:1133) and reverseBranchCondition (:1220) go through getBrCond and getOppositeBranchCondition, so they need no edits of their own. The PULP cases in getBrCond ignore Imm, so insertBranch's getBrCond(CC, Cond[2].isImm()) returns P_*. CORE-V is left as it is at 20 (CV_* still maps to COND_EQ/NE plus Imm), which fits the task: upstream's change of the CORE-V mapping and the getBrCond signature is step-21 material. optimizeCondBranch (:1240-1241): adding the new codes to the EQ/NE early return keeps the old control flow exactly, since P_* used to arrive there as EQ/NE and returned. Upstream later made the same exclusion explicit in cca44e030ddd (confirmed to exist). No PULP select-with-immediate pseudo exists (no Select_*_Imm or IntCCtoRISCVCC use in RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td), so upstream's IntCCtoRISCVCCCV part has no PULP counterpart. The verifier (:2597) accepts any value below COND_INVALID.
checks.passes_cluster: PULPHardwareLoops.cpp:612-617 and SNITCHFrepLoops.cpp:1328-1333 put the new codes under the EQ/NE cases, which gives the same Comparison kind as before. Cross-check: the only place either pass reads a condition code is Cond[0].getImm() -> getComparisonKindFromCC (PULPHardwareLoops.cpp:740/770, SNITCHFrepLoops.cpp:1000/1001). The other analyzeBranch calls (PULPHardwareLoops.cpp:515,704,717,1304,1520; SNITCHFrepLoops.cpp:446,949,1145) use only TB/FB or success/failure. getComparisonKind (PULPHardwareLoops.cpp:1524) switches on opcodes, which already list P_BEQIMM/P_BNEIMM, and is not affected. No other CC switch exists in PULP/ or Snitch/. Elsewhere in lib/Target/RISCV, RISCVRedundantCopyElimination.cpp:80-83 requires Cond[2].isReg() (never true for P_*), and the CC uses in ISelLowering, ExpandPseudo and commute only see select/CCMOV pseudos, which never carry the new codes. No .td file hard-codes CondCode values.
